h: APC accuses Atiku and ADC of a fake news plot against Tinubu's Kaduna rally
p: The ruling party has reportedly accused Atiku Abubakar and the ADC of spreading false reports to sabotage its campaign flag-off in Kaduna. There was no immediate response from the ADC camp in the reports seen. The ADC has reportedly fired back, rejecting the deepfake claims and challenging the APC to provide evidence.
more: The rally is the first big stop of the APC re-election campaign.
The ADC has been busy with its own campaign council inauguration in Abuja this weekend.
